description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Order under the Registered Stock & Securities Ordinance to raise of loan in Sri Lanka by the creation & issue of Treasury Bonds (S & E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Registered Stock and Securities Ordinance to authorize the raising of government loans through Treasury Bonds. It references specific legal authorities (Ordinance No. 07 of 1937 and subsequent amendments) and outlines the regulatory framework for bond issuance, including interest rates, payment schedules, and redemption terms. While it mentions the Minister of Finance by name, the core content focuses on legal/regulatory financial instruments rather than personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
